moments.title: Queen of Pop Madonna turns 68
moments.blurb: The iconic singer, songwriter, and actress Madonna celebrates her 68th birthday on Sunday, marking decades as a pop culture trailblazer.

angles.name: Pop Queen Reign
angles.copy: Still the Queen of Pop! Madonna turns 68 this Sunday, August 16th. What's your ultimate Madonna track?

angles.name: Iconic Influence
angles.copy: Happy 68th to the one and only Madonna! From 'Like A Virgin' to 'Vogue,' her influence is undeniable. Which era is your favourite?

moments.title: Led Zeppelin legend Robert Plant is 78
moments.blurb: The legendary voice of Led Zeppelin, Robert Plant, celebrates his 78th birthday on Wednesday, renowned for his powerful vocals and influential career in rock music.

angles.name: Rock Icon

angles.name: Enduring Voice
angles.copy: From 'Stairway to Heaven' to his incredible solo work, Robert Plant turns 78 this week. A true rock legend!
